name: Micah
lede: The thirty-third book of the Bible, in full: the word of Jehovah that came to Micah the Morashtite concerning Samaria and Jerusalem — the mountains melted as wax, Zion plowed as a field; then the mountain of Jehovah's house, swords into plowshares, every man under his vine and under his fig-tree; Beth-lehem Ephrathah; what doth Jehovah require of thee; and who is a God like unto thee — every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: Swords into Plowshares
books.blurb: Hear, ye peoples: Jehovah cometh forth out of his place, and the mountains shall be melted under him; Samaria a heap of the field; I will lament and wail — tell it not in Gath; woe to them that devise iniquity upon their beds; the breaker is gone up before them; ye heads of Jacob, Zion shall be plowed as a field; but in the latter days the mountain of Jehovah's house — they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and sit every man under his vine and under his fig-tree.
